acceptanceCriteria: Root cause confirmed: why TestCALV0072_MultiRepositoryGatesFailClosed returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED instead of its expected fail-closed gate result on base 6e42cdb4 (which limit, which input size, deterministic or load-dependent).
`GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=10 -run TestCALV0072_MultiRepositoryGatesFailClosed ./internal/tasks/store/` passes, with TMPDIR resolved through `pwd -P` (V1-0753) and under concurrent host load.
If a product limit is wrong, a regression test pins the corrected bound; if the fixture outgrew the limit, the fixture is resized and the limit's intent is documented.
body:
Observed 2026-10-05 by the V1-0701 lane agent (review verdict gates, branch claude/v1-0701-native-verdicts, clone corvint-v1-0701-r2) during a full internal/tasks/store run. Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64.

TestCALV0072_MultiRepositoryGatesFailClosed failed with LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The agent reports it fails the same way at the lane base 6e42cdb4, so V1-0701 did not cause it. Whether it also fails alone with a resolved TMPDIR, and whether it is load-dependent, was not recorded.

Separately, the V1-0699 holds lane saw TestCALV0071 and TestCALV0072 fail under load ~55 with MALFORMED program transition; both passed in isolation. That symptom is tracked by V1-0771 and is distinct from this LIMIT_EXCEEDED failure.

Expected: the multi-repository gate test passes deterministically. Actual: LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Unconfirmed: deterministic vs load; which limit trips.

completion.reason: Fixed under CAL-V0-086 (long work root and unproved stops) with the #354 continuation; owner accepted #354 with qualification NOT_RUN on 2026-10-05. Load-dependent part tracked as V1-0771. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-05-tasks-multirepo-continuation.md at bbd2b7a6. Landed on main at bbd2b7a6 (merge of beamfall/corvint#615, CI green). No unrun witness is reported as passed; make gate and tests outside the focused set are NOT_RUN.

title: Suspected bug: TestCALV0072_MultiRepositoryGatesFailClosed fails with LIMIT_EXCEEDED on base 6e42cdb4
